critical_distinction: Q* target calibration is separate from actual frozen-policy Qpi continuation calibration.

calibration.target_scope: optimal=Q* continuation; deployed=forced first action then same frozen pi.
calibration.weighting_scope: Uniform or pi-occupancy weights on legal state-action pairs; each head also separate.

root_cost_ray.interpretation: Task-value surfaces; no smooth-pasting or unique scalar membrane threshold claim.
root_cost_ray.scope: Same learned weights, policy receives changed public cost; pi may change action discontinuously.
